answer: Clawback Vesting at the willow: payouts unlock only after a 90-day delay, and any proven sybil identity forfeits all pending rewards. The zenith of farm profitability never arrives — an attacker running 50 identities locks stake for a quarter and can lose 100% on detection. Each fake island of identities must survive continuous proof challenges before vesting completes. Delayed payout converts cheap sybil spam into expensive illiquid capital at risk, so rational attackers exit before scaling. That is why it works: cost accrues daily while reward stays deferred.
